Homeless (SUH)’ scheme under Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Urban 
Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM), through respective States/Union Territories. 
The guidelines of SUH provide for conducting systematic third party surveys in 
cities/towns by the urban local bodies to identify the number of urban homeless in 
order to assess the need for shelters. So far, 2,45,945 urban homeless have been 
identified in surveys conducted by respective States/ Union Territories (UTs). 
 
(b) to (e): Land and Colonisation are State subjects. Identification of eligible beneficiaries 
including homeless is done by States/ UTs. The Union Government is augmenting 
efforts of States/Union Territories (UTs) Governments through Pradhan Mantri 
Awas Yojana-Urban (PMAY-U) to meet the housing demand through financial 
assistance to States/UTs. So far, 1,12,95,047 houses have been sanctioned, out of 
these 50,16,899 houses have been constructed and delivered to the beneficiaries 
under PMAY-U.  
   Further, under DAY-NULM, so far, 1,602 shelters for urban homeless are 
operational in States/ UTs with a total capacity of 87,745 persons.

URBAN DROUGHT POLICY OF THE COUNTRY 
 
NO. 2624. SHRI SANJAY SINGH: 
 
Will the Minister of HOUSING AND URBAN AFFAIRS be pleased to state: 
 
(a)  whether there has been no urban drought policy in the country resulting States 
 face massive water shortages and inequity, especially in urban poor areas and the 
 current drought policy only includes deficits and impacts on agricultural production, 
 loss of rural livelihoods, food, and water insecurity; 
(b)  if so, details thereof and if not, reasons for not having such policy; 
(c)  whether in water-scarce areas in country, people receive less than 35 litres per 
 person per day which is significantly lower as compared to the standards of 135L per 
 person per day suggested by Ministry; and 
(d)  steps taken for the same? 
                                                                ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF STATEIN THE  
MINISTRY OFHOUSING AND URBAN AFFAIRS 
(SHRI KAUSHAL KISHORE) 
 
(a) &  (b): Although no urban drought policy has been formulated so far, several policies and 
programme initiatives have been taken to promote water conservation in the country.  
 
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs has formulated Unified Building Bye Laws 
(UBBL) of Delhi, 2016; Model Building Bye Laws (MBBL), 2016 circulated for all the 
States / Union Territories (UTs) and Urban and Regional Development Plan Formulation and 
Implementation (URDPFI) Guidelines, 2014for adoptionsuiting their local 
conditions.Adequate focus has been given in these model bye laws /guidelines on the 
requirement of rainwater harvesting and water conservation measures. MBBL has indicative 
provisions for water harvesting in various types of buildings along with responsibility of 
Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) for rainwater harvesting in public spaces and provisions for 
enforcement and monitoring. As per MBBL, “all buildings having a plot size of 100 square 
meter or more, while submitting the building plans for sanction, shall mandatorily include the 
complete proposal of rainwater harvesting”.  This feature has been adopted by 33 States/ 
UTs. 
...2/- 
 
314

 
-2- 
 
National Water Policy (2012)formulated by Department of Water Resources, River 
Development & Ganga Rejuvenation, advocates inter-aliarainwater harvesting and 
conservation of water. It highlights the need for augmenting the availability of water through 
direct use of rainfall. It also advocates conservation of river bodies and prevention of 
encroachment and diversion of water bodies and drainage channels. 
 
Ministry of Jal Shakti has circulated a Model Bill to all the States/UTs to enable them 
to enact suitable ground water legislation for regulation of its development, which also 
includes provision of RWH. So far, 19 States/ Union Territories (UTs) have adopted and 
implemented the ground water legislation. 
 
(c)  & (d): Supply of 135 litre per capita per day (lpcd) water has been suggested as the 
benchmark for urban water supply.  However, actual supply of water to householdsin urban 
areas depends on availability of water for supply. 
 
 Water supply is a State subject and it is the responsibility of States and ULBs to 
ensure adequate water supply to the households. Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs 
supplements the efforts of States /UTs through its flagship schemes, such as Atal Mission for 
Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT). 
 
AMRUTwas launched by the Government of India on June 25, 2015 in selected 500 
cities and towns across the country. It focuses on development of basic infrastructure in the 
Mission cities in the sectors of water supply, sewerage & septage management, storm water 
drainage, green spaces and parks, non-motorized urban transport.  Under AMRUT, out of the 
total plan size of ₹77, 640 crore, ₹39,010 crore (50%) has been allocated to water supply 
only.  
 
So far, against the assessed gap of 139 lakh water tap connections, around 107 lakh 
connections have been providedunder AMRUT or in convergence with other schemes. 
Further, 106 waterbodies with an area of 108 acre have been taken up for rejuvenation under 
AMRUT.

TRANSPARENCY IN REAL ESTATE SECTOR 
 
 NO. 2626. SHRI AYODHYA RAMI  REDDY: 
  
 
 Will the Minister of HOUSING AND URBAN AFFAIRS be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act (RERA), 2016 was passed 
 with a view to protect the interests of real estate purchasers and promoting an 
 environment of transparency in the real estate sector; 
 
(b) whether there has been a deepening trust deficit between real estate builders and buyers; 
 
(c) whether the State Governments were supposed to establish their RERAs within one year 
 of the passage of Act; and 
 
(d) if so, whether a few states have not complied with the aboveprovisions till date? 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF STATE IN THE  
MINISTRY OF HOUSING AND URBAN AFFAIRS 
(SHRI KAUSHAL KISHORE) 
 
 (a) & (b):Yes Sir, The Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016 (RERA) was enacted in 
March, 2016 to ensure regulation and promotion of Real Estate Sector in an efficient and 
transparent manner and protect the interest of homebuyers.As per Section 20 of the RERA, 
the ‘Appropriate Government’ i.e. the States/UTs are required to establish Real Estate 
Regulatory Authority to regulate and promote the real estate sector in the respective States/ 
Union Territories (UTs).The Real Estate Regulatory Authority of the concerned State/UT is 
required to register and regulate real estate projects and real estate agents registered under 
RERA and further publish and maintain a web portal, containing relevant details of all real 
estate projects for which registration has been given, for public viewing. 
 No specific instances have been brought to the notice of the Ministry of Housing and Urban 
Affairs indicating a deepening trust deficit between real estate builders and buyers. 
(c) & (d): Section 84 of RERA mandates States / UTs to notify rules for carrying out the provisions of 
RERA, within a period of six months of the commencement of this Act. As on 31
stJuly, 
2021, 35 States and Union Territories (UTs) have notified rules under RERA and 30 
States/UTs have set up Real Estate Regulatory Authority.

DISPOSAL OF SOLID WASTES UNDER SBM-U 
 
NO. 2632. SHRI  M. SHANMUGAM: 
 
Will the Minister of HOUSING AND URBAN AFFAIRS be pleased to state: 
  
(a) whether Government has set the target of 100 percent scientific processing and disposal 
 of solid waste under Swachh Bharat Mission-Urban (SBM-U); 
(b) if so, the details thereof and action taken by Government in this regard; 
(c) whether any road map is being prepared and if so, the details thereof;  
(d) the steps proposed to be taken to dispose of several tonnes of municipal waste garbage 
 that Indian cities and towns generate which otherwise goes to landfill sites or dumping 
 yards untreated; and 
(e) the assistance and technical know-how to be provided to State Governments to address 
 the issue? 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF STATE IN THE  
MINISTRY OF HOUSING AND URBAN AFFAIRS  
(SHRI KAUSHAL KISHORE) 
 
(a) to (d) : One of the objectives of Swachh Bharat Mission-Urban (SBM-U) is to get 100% 
scientific management of Municipal Solid Waste (MSW). Under SBM-U, Government provides 
Central Assistance (CA) up to 35% of the Project Cost as Viability Gap Funding (VGF) to the 
States/ Union Territory Administrations for creation of solid waste processing facilities in Urban 
Local Bodies (ULBs). Till date, scientific processing of MSW has increased to 68% from 18% in 
2014. To enhance the solid waste processing capacity to 100% and to prevent untreated waste 
going to landfill sites, Hon’ble Finance Minister in her Budget Speech has announced 
implementation of Swachh Bharat Mission 2.0, with a total financial outlay of ₹1,41,678/- crore, 
over a period of five years 2021-2026, addressing inter-alia, processing of municipal solid waste, 
management of construction and demolition waste and bio-remediation of all legacy dumpsites. 
 
(e) : Apart from the Central assistance released to the States/Union Territory Administrations as 
mentioned above, Ministry has issued several advisories covering all components of Municipal 
Solid Waste Management right from collection and transportation to landfill reclamation.

HOUSING IN KARNATAKA 
 
NO. 2635. SH. K.C. RAMAMURTHY:  
 
 
Will the Minister of HOUSING AND URBAN AFFAIRS be pleased to state: 
 
(a)  whether Government had targeted to complete 93,000 houses in 2016-17, 52,200 in 
2017-18 and no target had been fixed for 2018-19 in Karnataka; 
(b)  if so, the number of houses so far completed out of the above target fixed by 
Government in Karnataka so far, district-wise; 
(c)  the reasons that no target has been fixed for 2018-19 and details of target fixed for 
2019-20,2020-21 and 2021-22; and 
(d)  by when Ministry will complete sanctioned houses and hand them over to the 
beneficiaries? 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF STATE IN THE  
MINISTRY OF HOUSING AND URBAN AFFAIRS 
(SHRI KAUSHAL KISHORE) 
 
(a) to (c): No Sir. Under the Pradhan Manti Awas Yojana-Urban [PMAY-U], 
Government of India does not fix any target for year-wise construction of houses in a 
State/Union Territory (UT). Houses under PMAY-U are sanctioned for eligible 
beneficiaries based on the project proposals submitted to the Ministry of Housing and 
Urban Affairs with due approval of the State/UT Governments. States/UTs are required 
to undertake a demand assessment and validate the same to determine the actual 
requirement of houses to be built under PMAY-U during the period of Housing for All 
Mission by March 2022. At present, the assessed demand for houses in Karnataka under 
PMAY-U is 7.00 lakh; against which 6.91 lakh houses have been sanctioned. District-
wise details of houses sanctioned and completed under the scheme in the State of 
Karnataka so far is annexed.  
 
(d): Projects sanctioned under PMAY (U) are implemented by the State Government 
through Urban Local Bodies/Implementing Agencies as per the time schedule mentioned 
in the respective Detailed Project Reports (DPRs) approved by the State Government. All 
the houses sanctioned under PMAY-U are to be completed and occupied by identified 
beneficiaries within the mission period of ‘Housing for All’ by March2022.

 The Government is providing fiscal stimulus of more than Rs. twenty seven

employment opportunities. 
 
 Government of India has taken a number of initiatives for promoting 
employment generation in the country. Aatmanirbhar Bharat Rojgar Yojana (ABRY) 
has been launched w.e.f. 1st October, 2020 to incentivize employers for creation of 
new employment along with social security benefits and restoration of employment. 
The new employees under the scheme includes those who have lost their 
employment during Covid-19 pandemic and did n’t join in any EPF covered 
establishment upto 30.09.2020.The terminal date for registration of beneficiary under 
the scheme has been extended from 30th June, 2021 to 31st March, 2022. 
 
 Under Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Yojana (PMGKY), Government of India has 
contributed both 12% employer’s share and 12% employee’s share under Employees 
Provident Fund (EPF), totaling 24% of the wage for the wage month from March to 
August, 2020 for  the establishments having upto 100 employees with 90% of such 
employees earning less than Rs. 15000/-.This has helped in protecting employment in 
EPFO registered establishments during post Covid period. 
 
 Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) is being implemented by the Government 
inter alia, for facilitating self-employment. Under PMMY collateral free loans upto Rs. 
10 lakh, are extended to micro/small business enterprises and to individuals to 
enable them to setup or expand their business activities.

Rs.10,000/- for one-year tenure to street vendors, to help them resume their 
businesses during the post Covid period.   
 
 In addition, RBI and Government of India have taken several monetary and 
liquidity measures to keep the flow of credit uninterrupted to the productive sectors 
of the economy including MSME sector. 
 
 Besides above, Government has taken various steps for generating 
employment in the country like encouraging various projects involving substantial

2647. SHRI PRASHANTA NANDA: 
 
 Will the Minister of Labour and Employment be pleased to state:

scheme that protects them from industry based life-time illness/disorders; 
and 
(b) if so, what illness or medical conditions are covered under the scheme? 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE FOR LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT  
(SHRI RAMESWAR TELI) 
 
(a) & (b): Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) and Pradhan

and  disability cover to  the  unorganised workers. The benefits under the 
schemes are Rs. 2.00 lakh on death due to any reason and permanent 
disability, Rs. 4.00 lakh on death due to accident and Rs. 1.00 lakh on partial 
disability. The total annual premium for both the schemes is Rs. 342/-. The 
premium is to be borne by the individual which is available through banks. 
 
             The Ayushman Bharat- Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-
PMJAY), a universal health scheme launched in 2018, provides health 
insurance of up to Rs. 5.00 lakhs per family for secondary and tertiary 
treatments/hospitalisation free of cost. The beneficiary families under 
Ayushman Bharat Scheme have been identified on the basis of Socio 
Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011. The treatment packages under AB- 
PMJAY are very comprehensive, covering in-patient care for 1668 procedures 
across 25 different specialties that include super specialty care like 
oncology, neurosurgery, and cardio-thoracic and cardiovascular surgery, etc. 
 
             Further, the workers who are not covered under the provisions of 
Employees State Insurance Act, 1948, the provisions of Employees 
Compensation Act, 1923 are applicable to them as per Schedule II (category 
of employment) and Schedule III (occupational diseases) of this Act and 
compensation to such workers is decided accordingly.

(c) the reasons for Government not providing unemployed citizens with unemployment 
benefits?

MINISTER OF STATE FOR LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT 
(SHRI RAMESWAR TELI) 
 
(a) to (c):   COVID-19 pandemic has affected all sections of the society including 
organised/ unorganised workers. Government has taken several initiatives to address the 
challenges and threats posed by the pandemic. Fiscal stimulus of more than Rs. Twenty 
seven lakh crore is being provided as part of the Aatmanirbhar financial Package, 
comprising of various long term schemes/programmes/ policies for making the country 
self-reliant and to create employment opportunities.  
 
Aatmanirbhar Bharat Rojgar Yojana (ABRY) has been launched w.e.f. 1st October, 2020 to 
incentivize employers for creation of new employment along with social security benefits 
and restoration of employment. The new employees under the scheme includes those who 
have lost their employment during Covid-19 pandemic and did n’t join in any EPF covered

lockdown. 
 
433

contributed both 12% employer’s share and 12% employee’s share under Employees 
Provident Fund (EPF), totaling 24% of the wage for the wage month from March to August, 
2020 for  the establishments having upto 100 employees with 90% of such employees 
earning less than Rs. 15000/-.This has helped in providing employment in EPFO registered 
establishments during post Covid period. 
 
Government had launched the Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyaan (GKRA) of 125 days on 20th 
June, 2020 to boost employment and livelihood opportunities for returnee migrant 
workers and similarly affected persons including youth in rural areas, in 116 selected 
districts across 6 States of Bihar, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh, Odisha, Rajasthan and 
Uttar Pradesh.

implemented by the Employees’ State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) has been enhanced to 
50% from 25% of the average wage, payable upto 90 days, alongwith relaxation of 
eligibility conditions to claim the benefit. 
 
Government is encouraging various projects involving substantial investment and through 
public expenditure on schemes like Prime Minister’s Employment Generation Programme 
(PMEGP), Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS), Pt. 
Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY), Deendayal Antodaya 
Yojana-National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM), Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas 
Yojana (PMKVY) etc. 
 
Government has increased MGNREGA wage to Rs. 202 a day from Rs. 182 to benefit 
nearly 13.62 crore families. 
 
Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) is being implemented by the Government inter alia, 
for facilitating self-employment. Under PMMY collateral free loans upto Rs. 10 lakh, are 
extended to micro/small business enterprises and to individuals to enable them to setup 
or expand their business activities. 
 
In addition, RBI and Government of India have introduced measures to infuse liquidity in 
the economy to sustain the market economy and raise the level of employment.

Bharat Mission, Smart City Mission, Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban 
Transformation, Housing for All, Infrastructure development and Industrial corridors and 
Production-Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme have the potential to generate productive and 
sustainable employment opportunities.

provides social security benefits, namely medical benefit, sickness benefit, 
maternity benefit, disablement benefit, dependents benefit, etc. 
  
The Code on Social Security, 2020 (the Code) notified on 29.09.2020 and 
envisages framing of schemes for unorganised workers, gig workers and 
platform workers to be implemented through the Employees’ State Insurance 
Corporation (ESIC) and   Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO). 
Further, the Code for the first time enables an establishment having less than 
ten persons to join ESIC on voluntary basis.      
 
(b): The  V.V. Giri National Labour Institute had conducted a study on the 
subject “Towards Workers Living and Working Conditions with Special 
Reference to Improving the Road Transport System in India”  and had submitted 
its report to the Government in  2009. The four Labour Codes viz. the Code on 
Wages, 2019, the Code on Industrial Relations, 2020, the Code on Social 
Security, 2020 and the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions 
Code, 2020 have addressed the issues including minimum w ages to all workers 
whether in organised or unorganised sectors and social security benefits 
through formulation of schemes.

PROTECTION OF MIGRANT WORKERS 
 
2655. SHRI BIKASH RANJAN BHATTACHARYYA: 
 
 Will the Minister of Labour and Employment  be pleased to 
state: 
 
(a) whether there is any proposal to reinstate the repealed Inter-
State Migrant Workers  Act, 1979 in the improved forms given the 
gravity of migrant workers’ unimaginable sufferings during these 
lockdown; and 
(b) if not, what are other legislations to protect these workers in 
view of the inadequacy of Occupational Safety, Health and Working 
Conditions Code, 2020 which repealed the Inter- State Migrant 
Workers Act, 1979? 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE FOR LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT  
(SHRI RAMESWAR TELI) 
 
(a) & (b): Government had enacted the Inter-state Migrant Workmen 
(Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act, 1979 to 
safeguard the interests of the inter-state migrant workers. This Act 
has now been subsumed in the Occupational Safety, Health and 
Working Conditions (OSH) Code, 2020. The Inter-State Migrant 
Workmen (RECS) Act, 1979 will get repealed as soon as OSH Code, 
2020 comes into force. 
 
Contd..2/- 
446

:: 2 :: 
Recently enacted four Labour Codes viz.   Code on Wages, 
2019, Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code,  
2020, Code on Social Security  2020 and the Industrial Relations 
Code, 2020 provide for decent working conditions, minimum wages 
and social security benefits to all category of workers including 
migrant workers. Special provisions such as widening the definition of 
Inter-state migrant workers, toll free helpline, journey allowance, etc. 
for migrant workers have been incorporated in the OSH Code, 2020.  
 
The Unorganized Workers’ Social Security Act, 2008, now 
subsumed in the C ode on Social Security, 2020, provides for social 
security to all unorganized workers including migrant workers. 
Government has launched in 2015 Social Security Schemes like  
Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bi ma Yojana (PMJJBY) and Pradhan 
Mantri Suraksha Beema  Yojana (PMSBY) for life and disability cover 
and Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Man Dhan Pension Yojana (PM-SYM) in 
March, 2019 for pension to the unorganised workers including migrant 
workers. Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana 
(PMJAY) launched in 2018 provides Rs.5 lakh health coverage for 
secondary and tertiary health benefits to all unorganized workers 
including migrant workers who are covered as eligible beneficiaries as 
per Socio Economic Caste census Data, 2011.  
 
Further, Ministry has developed a National Data Base for 
Unorganised Workers (NDUW) portal, seeded with Aadhaar, for 
registration of unorganised workers including migrant workers.   
Government has also launched an All India Survey on 
Migrant Workers with the objective to collect data on migrant workers  
in the country including  impact of COVID – 19 on  such workers.

with the extant guidelines in this regard. Thus, it is up to the airlines to provide

THE MINISTER OF STEEL     (SHRI RAM CHANDRA PRASAD SINGH)

2666. DR. NARENDRA JADHAV: 
 
   Will the Minister of LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the percentage of female labour force participation rate in the country 
during COVID- 19, the details thereof; 
 
(b) the number of women that have dropped out of work from both formal and 
informal sectors for the year 2020-21 due to COVID-19, the details thereof; 
 
(c) whether any financial assistance was provided to the women who were laid 
off by employers in between March, 2020 to June, 2021; the details thereof; 
 
(d) if not, the reasons therefor; and 
 
(e) the details of steps taken by Government to increase women participation 
in workforce? 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE FOR LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT 
(SHRI RAMESWAR TELI) 
 
(a) to (e): As per the results of Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) conducted by 
National Statistical Office (NSO), Ministry of Statistics & Programme 
Implementation (MOSPI)during 2017-18, 2018-19 and 2019-20, the estimated 
Female Labour force participation rate (LFPR) on usual status for 15 years and 
above is 23.3%, 24.5% and 30.0%, respectively. The survey period is from July to 
June of a year. 
 
Aatmanirbhar Bharat Rojgar Yojana (ABRY) has been launched w.e.f. 1 stOctober, 
2020 to incentivize employers for creation of new employment along with social 
security benefits and restoration of employment. This scheme being implemented 
through EPFO seeks to reduce the financial burden of the employers and 
encourages them to hire more workers. The new employees under the scheme 
include those who lost their jobs during Covid-19 and did not join in any EPF 
471

covered establishment upto 30.09.2020. The terminal date for registration of 
beneficiaries has been extended from 30.06.2021 to 31.03.2022. As on 4th 
August, 2021, 25.78 lakh total beneficiaries have availed the benefits under the 
scheme; out of which 3.52 lakh beneficiaries are rejoinees who have rejoined 
after 1stOctober, 2020. This includes 0.77 lakh women rejoinees. 
 
The unemployment benefit under the Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana being 
implemented by the Employees’ State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) has been 
enhanced to 50% from 25% of the average wage, payable upto 90 days, alongwith 
relaxation of eligibility conditions to claim the benefit. Till 30.06.2021, benefit 
has been given to 15981 female beneficiaries.  
 
Government has taken various steps to improve women’s participation in the 
labour force and quality of their employment. A number of protective provisions 
have been incorporated in the labour laws for equal opportunity and congenial 
work environment for women workers. These includes enhancement in paid 
maternity leave from 12 weeks to 26 weeks, provision for mandatory crèche 
facility in the establishments having 50 or more employees, permitting women 
workers in the night shifts with adequate safety measures, etc.  
 
Employment of women in the aboveground mines including opencast workings 
has been allowed between 7 pm and 6 am, and in below ground working between 
6 am and 7 pm in technical, supervisory and managerial work where continuous 
presence may not be required.  
 
The Equal Remuneration Act, 1976 now subsumed in the Code on Wages, 2019 
provides that there shall be no discrimination in an establishment or any unit 
thereof among employees on the ground of gender in matters relating to wages 
by the same employer, in respect of the same work or work of similar nature 
done by any employee. Further, no employer shall make any discrimination on the 
ground of sex while recruiting any employee for the same work or work of similar 
nature in the conditions of employment, except where the employment of women 
in such work is prohibited or restricted by or under any law for the time being in 
force.  
 
To enhance the employability of female workers, the Government is providing 
training to them through a network of Women Industrial Training institutes, 
National Vocational Training Institutes and Regional Vocational Training 
Institutes.

Workers (NDUW) and when it will be released in public domain;

2690. SHRI SAMBHAJI CHHATRAPATI: 
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to state: 
(a) whether Government is seriously pushing for use of indigenous fuels such as 
ethanol, methanol and bio-CNG to reduce the cost of operation of petrol/ 
diesel driven vehicles in the country and reduce import of petroleum 
products; 
(b) if so, the details thereof including the compatibility of petrol/diesel driven 
vehicles to run on indigenous fuels also ; 
(c) whether Government has issued directions to automobile industry for 
production of vehicles which may run on indigenous fuel ; and

fuels?

****** 
(a) to (c): Government is promoting use of domestically produced biofuels with 
multiple objectives of associated environmental benefits, boost to agriculture 
sector and reducing imports of petroleum crude. Programmes such as Ethanol 
Blended Petrol (EBP) Programme; Biodiesel Blending Programme; Sustainable 
Alternative Towards Affordable Transportation (SATAT) Programme for 
Compressed Bio-Gas (CBG) are being implemented across the country involving 
various stakeholders. Under the aforesaid programmes the biofuel blended product 
intended to be used in petrol / diesel / Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) driven 
vehicles has to meet the Bureau of Indian Standard (BIS) specifications released 
from time to time. Currently, Public Sector Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs) are

ONGC BARGE ACCIDENT  
  
2701.       SMT. PHULO DEVI NETAM:  
         
  
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to state: 
  
 
(a)  the details of the communications from Oil and Natural Gas Corporation 
(ONGC) to all installations warning them of cyclone Tauktae, including the dates of 
such communications and the recipient installations;  
 
(b)  whether the Ministry has constituted a High Level Committee to probe the 
sinking of the ONGC barge P-305; and   
 
(c)  if so, the details thereof including the date of such constitution, the persons 
appointed to such Committee, and any findings of the Committee thus far and if not, 
the reasons therefor?   
 
ANSWER  
 
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS 
(SHRI RAMESWAR TELI) 
  
 (a)
: The chronological details of the communications from ONGC to all installations 
regarding cyclone Tauktae are as under:-  
 
11-05-2021
 
India Meteorological Department (IMD) issued first advisory (press release) on 
cyclone Tauktae at 14:00 hours.  
 
12-05-2021
 
The IMD advisory was discussed in Joint Operation Review Meeting (JORM) of 
Mumbai Offshore, ONGC.  Deliberations with all senior officers of the Mumbai region 
on the urgency of cyclone preparedness were held. All Platforms/Rigs/ Vessels were 
asked to take action and also due precautions as per Emergency Response Plan 
(ERP), Regional Contingency Plan (RCP) and Corporate Disaster Management Plan 
(CDMP). 
Rig move cell at Western Offshore, Mumbai issued an advisory to all the rigs 
deployed in Western offshore to be prepared to take precautionary measures as 
538

mentioned in the rig-specific Marine Operating Manual / SOP / Cyclone Contingency 
Plan, if situation eventually warrants. 
 
13-05-2021 
The weather advisory received via email at 08:30 pm from Maritime Rescue 
Coordination Centre (Mumbai) (MRCC) at Radio Room (Commission-One) at 
Vasudhara Bhavan in Mumbai was informed to all ONGC Installations, Rigs and 
Vessels at 08:37 pm with an advice to take preventive actions/measures as per 
Standard Operating Procedures (SOP). All barges in the field were instructed by 
respective installations over radio communication to plan for movement to safe 
location, in view of the impending cyclone. 
 
14-05-2021
 
IMD issued an update along with Track Forecast of Tropical Disturbance. Informed 
all concerned about plot of Path of the Tropical Disturbance with respect to rigs / 
installations and the General Advisory. ONGC asked all the Barges in field to move 
to safe locations. 
 
15-05-2021
 
IMD Cyclone Advisory Bulletin regarding cyclone conveyed to all the installations, 
rigs and vessels by mail (08:47 pm) from ONGC Radio Room (Commission-One) at 
Vasudhara Bhavan in Mumbai.  ONGC Drilling Section had a video conferencing 
with all stakeholders. The rigs were conveyed to go into storm survival mode from 
the evening of 16th May 2021. 
 
16-05-2021
 
Considering the enormity of the cyclone, an Emergency Control Room was set up in 
Vasudhara Bhavan to co-ordinate with all installations, ODAG, Commission-One 
Radio Room, Helibase Radio Room, Nhava Radio Room etc. 
The Base control room/ radio room was in constant coordination with Rigs, 
platforms, ODAG, Helibase radio room, Nhava radio room during the cyclone 
Tauktae. 
 
(b) and (c)
: To inquire into the sequence of events leading to the stranding of ONGC 
vessels and accidents, the Government  has constituted  a High Level Committee, 
on 19.05.2021, consisting  of following members:  
(1) Shri Amitabh Kumar, Director General of Shipping 
(2) Shri S.C.L. Das, DG-DGH 
(3) Smt. Nazli Jafri Shayin, Joint Secretary, Ministry of Defence 
 
The committee has not yet submitted final report.

Programme on National Policy on Biofuels, 2018  
 
2702. SHRI RAJMANI PATEL: 
   SMT. PHULO DEVI NETAM: 
 
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the progress made towards the target of 20 per cent ethanol blending in petrol 
by 2030 as stated in the National Policy on Biofuels 2018, including the 
current percentage of the same; 
(b) the current percentage of blending of biodiesel in diesel ; 
(c) whether Government is adhering to the indicative target of 5 per cent blending 
of biodiesel in diesel by 2030 as proposed by the National Policy on Biofuels 
2018; and 
(d) if so, the details of the same including the progress made towards achieving 
this target and if not, the reasons therefor? 
 
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF PETROLEUM & 
NATURAL GAS  
 (SHRI RAMESWAR TELI) 
****** 
(a): The Government has taken various steps towards achieving 20% blending of 
ethanol in petrol which includes allowing use of sugarcane and food grains (maize 
and surplus stocks of rice with Food Corporation of India)  for conversion to 
ethanol; administered price mechanism for procurement of ethanol under EBP 
Programme including enhanced ex-mill price of ethanol year on year from ethanol 
supply year 2017; lowered GST rate to 5% on ethanol for EBP Programme; 
amendment in Industries (Development & Regulation) Act for free movement of 
ethanol; interest subvention scheme for enhancement and augmentation of ethanol 
production capacity in the country. At present average ethanol blending percentage 
in petrol for the ongoing Ethanol Supply Year 2020-21 is 8.04% as on 02.08.2021. 
 
540

2/2 
 
(b) to (d): The present percentage of blending of biodiesel in diesel is less than 0.1 
percent. The National Policy on Biofuels – 2018 prescribes as indicative target of 
5% blending of biodiesel in diesel by 2030. 
 
Availability of biodiesel has been low in the last few years due to increase of price 
and non availability of feed stock for biodiesel. Some biodiesel is also being 
marketed by agencies other than Oil Marketing Companies. 
 
Further, to increase the supply of Biodiesel in the country, OMCs are regularly 
floating Expression of Interest (EoI) to encourage the production of biodiesel from 
Used Cooking Oil.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF STEEL 
 
RAJYA SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO.2720 
FOR ANSWER ON 11/08/2021 
 
MODERNISATION OF STEEL PLANTS 
 
2720. DR. C.M. RAMESH: 
 
Will the Minister of STEEL be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether Government proposes to modernise the various steel plants in the 
country to boost the performance of these plants, if so, the details thereof and if not, 
the reasons therefor; and 
 
(b) how many steel plants have been modernised during the last three years, the 
details thereof; and 
 
(c) whether any fund has been allocated for the purpose and if so, the amount 
spent on modernisation, the details thereof? 
 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF STEEL     (SHRI RAM CHANDRA PRASAD SINGH) 
 
(a)&(b): Steel is a de-regulated sector and the role of the Ministry is that of a 
facilitator.  Decision regarding modernization of steel plant is taken by individual 
company based on techno-commercial considerations.   
 
The two public sector steel companies viz. Steel Authority of India Limited 
(SAIL) and Rashtriya Ispat Nigam Limited (RINL) have modernised their steel plants 
progressively during the last decade.  These include steel plants of SAIL at Bhilai 
(Chhattisgarh), Bokaro (Jharkhand), Rourkela (Odisha), Durgapur (West Bengal), 
Burnpur (West Bengal) and of RINL at Visakhapatnam (Andhra Pradesh). 
 
(c) Government of India has not allocated any funds for modernisation of steel 
plants.  The modernisation of steel plants is funded by the respective steel sector 
company from its internal resources / borrowings.

क्या नागर विमानन मंत्री यह बताने की क ृ पा करेंगे वक :  
उडान योजना क े  अंतगगत जयपुर और उत्क े ला विमानपत्तन पर िावणखज्यक उडान आरंभ करने की 
समय सीमा क्या है? 
 
उत्तर 
 
नागर विमानन मंत्रालय में राज्य मंत्री (जनरल (डा.) , विजय क ु मार वसंह (सेिावनिृत्त) ) 
 
क्षेत्रीय संपक ग  रोजाना (आरसीएस) - उडान (उडे िेश का आम नागररक) क े  अंतगगत, जेयपोर एिं उतक े ला 
क े  मागग चयवनत एयरलाइन प्रचालकों (एसएओ) को उडान योजना क े  तहत उडानों क े  प्रचालन हेतु अिार्ग 
वकए गए थे। ति ् पश्चात, चयवनत एयरलाइन प्रचालकों द्वारा संवििा समझौते क े  प्रािधानों क े  गैर- अनुपालन 
क े  कारण अिार्ग वकए गए उडान मागग रद्द कर विये गए थे। रद्द/समाप्त वकए गए बोवलयों को हाल ही में 
आयोवजत उडान 4.1 क े  अंतगगत बोली प्रविया क े  विशेष िौर में प्रस्तुत वकया गया था एिं प्राप्त बोवलयों 
का मूल्ांकन वकया जा रहा है। चयवनत एयरलाइन प्रचालकों को अिार्ग पत्र जारी होने क े  6 महीने क े  
भीतर या हिाईअड्डे क े  तैयार होने की वतवथ से 2 महीने क े  भीतर प्रचालन शुरू करने की आिश्यकता 
है, जब तक वक वियान्वयन एजेंसी, भारतीय विमानपत्तन प्रावधकरण द्वारा कोई समय का विस्तार प्रिान 
न वकया गया हो।

(ग)  क्या अवज्ञधक श्रम बल सवेक्षण (पीएलएफएस) सज्ञहत नौकररयों से संबंज्ञधत सरकारी अंकडो को

श्रम और रोजगार राज्य मंत्री  
 (श्री रामेश्वर तेली) 
 
(क) से (ड.): रोजगार/बेरोजगारी से संबंज्ञधत अंकडे राष्ट्रीय सांज्ञख्यकी कायाषलय (एनएसओ), सांज्ञख्यकी एवं 
कायषक्रम कायाषन्वयन मंत्रालय (एमओएसपीअइ) द्वारा अयोज्ञजत ककए जाने वाले अवज्ञधक श्रम बल 
सवेक्षण (पीएलएफएस) के माध्यम से 2017-18 से एकत्र ककए जा रहे हैं। वार्षषक पीएलएफएस ररपोटष 
जुलाइ से जून की सवेक्षण ऄवज्ञध को सज्ञममज्ञलत करती है। पीएलएफएस ने हाल ही में शहरी क्षेत्रों हेतु  ालू 
साप्तज्ञहक ज्ञस्थज्ञत (सीडब््यूएस) पर त्रैमाज्ञसक बुलेरटन जारी ककया है। नवीनतम प्रकाशन जुलाइ-ज्ञसतमबर, 
2020 को समाप्त होने वाली ज्ञतमाही से संबंज्ञधत है। 
 
2018-19 एवं 2019-20 के दौरान अयोज्ञजत ककए गए वार्षषक अवज्ञधक श्रम बल सवेक्षण 
(पीएलएफएस) के पररणामों के ऄनुसार, देश में सामान्य ज्ञस्थज्ञत अधार पर 15 वषष एवं ईससे ऄज्ञधक अयु

 सरकार अत्मज्ञनभषर भारत ज्ञवत्तीय पैकेज के रूप में सत्ताइस लाख करोड रुपए से ऄज्ञधक का 
राजकोषीय प्रोत्साहन प्रदान कर रही है, आसमें देश को अत्मज्ञनभषर बनाने तथा रोजगार ऄवसर सृज्ञजत 
करने के ज्ञलए ज्ञवज्ञभन्न दीघषकाज्ञलक योजनाएं/कायषक्रम/नीज्ञतयां शाज्ञमल हैं।  
  
भारत सरकार  ने देश में रोजगार सृजन को प्रोत्साज्ञहत करने हेतु ऄनेक कदम ईठाए हैं। अत्मज्ञनभषर 
भारत रोजगार योजना (एबीअरवाइ) सामाज्ञजक सुरक्षा लाभों के साथ- साथ नए रोजगार के सृजन को 
प्रोत्साज्ञहत करने हेतु ज्ञनयोिाओं को प्रोत्साज्ञहत करने तथा रोजगार की पुनः बहाली हेतु 1 ऄिूबर, 2020 
से प्रारंभ की गइ है। आस योजना के तहत, नए कमष ाररयों में वे कमष ारी शाज्ञमल हैं जो कोज्ञवड-19 
महामारी के दौरान ऄपना रोजगार खो  ुके थे एवं 30.09.2020 तक इपीएफ से कवर ककसी प्रज्ञतष्ठान में 
ज्ञनयोज्ञजत नहीं थे। आस योजना के तहत लाभार्षथयों के पंजीकरण की ऄंज्ञतम ज्ञतज्ञथ को 30 जून, 2021 से 
बढाकर 31 मा ष, 2022 कर कदया गया है। 
 
प्रधान मंत्री गरीब क्याण योजना (पीएमजीकेवाइ) के तहत, भारत सरकार ने कमष ारी भज्ञवष्य 
ज्ञनज्ञध (इपीएफ) के तहत  ज्ञनयोिाओं के 12% ऄंशदान और कमष ाररयों के 12% के ऄंशदान-दोनों का 
योगदान ककया है, जो कक 100 कमष ाररयों तक रखने वाले प्रज्ञतष्ठानों के 90% ऐसे कमष ाररयों जो 
15000/- रुपए से कम ऄर्षजत करते हैं, के ज्ञलए मा ष से ऄगस्त, 2020 माह के वेतन माह हेतु कुल 24% 
है। आससे कोज्ञवड पश्च ऄवज्ञध के दौरान इपीएफओ से पंजीकृत प्रज्ञतष्ठानों में रोजगार प्रदान कराने में 
सहायता ज्ञमली है।  
 
सरकार ने स्व-रोजगार को सुकर बनाने के ज्ञलए, ऄन्य बातों के साथ-साथ, प्रधानमंत्री मुद्रा योजना 
(पीएमएमवाइ) भी अरंभ की है। पीएमएमवाइ के ऄंतगषत सूक्ष्म/लघु व्यापररक ईद्यमों तथा व्यज्ञियों को 
ऄपने व्यापाररक कायषकलापों को स्थाज्ञपत करने ऄथवा ज्ञवस्तार करने में समथष बनाने के ज्ञलए 10 लाख 
रुपए तक का गैर-जमानती ऋण प्रदान ककया जाता है। 
 
 पीएम -स्व-ज्ञनज्ञध योजना ने रेहडी-पटरी वालों को कोज्ञवड पश्च ऄवज्ञध के दौरान कफर से ऄपना 
व्यापार शुरू करने में सहायता के ज्ञलए एक वषष की ऄवज्ञध के ज्ञलए 10,000/- रु. तक का गैर-जमानती 
कायषकारी पूंजीगत ऋण प्रदान करने को सरल बनाया है। 
 
 आसके ऄलावा, अरबीअइ एवं भारत सरकार ने एमएसएमइ क्षेत्र सज्ञहत ऄथषव्यवस्था के ईत्पादक 
क्षेत्रों तक बाधा रज्ञहत क्रेज्ञडट प्रवाह को बनाए रखने के ज्ञलए ऄनेक मौकद्रक एवं तरलता ईपाय ककए हैं। 
 
ईपयुषि के ऄज्ञतररि, सरकार ने देश में रोजगार का सृजन करने के ज्ञलए पयाषप्त ज्ञनवेश वाली 
ज्ञवज्ञभन्न पररयोजनाओं को प्रोत्साहन देने और प्रधान मंत्री रोजगार सृजन कायषक्रम (पीएमइजीपी), महात् मा  
गांधी राष् रीय मीणामीण रोजगार गारंटी योजना (एमजीएनअरइजीएस), पं. दीन दयाल ईपाध् याय मीणामीण 
कौश् य योजना (डीडीयू-जीकेवाइ) तथा दीनदयाल ऄंत्योदय योजना - राष् रीय शहरी अजीज्ञवका ज्ञमशन 
(डीएवाइ-एनयूएलएम) जैसी योजनाओं पर सावषजज्ञनक व्यय में वृज्ञि करने जैसे ज्ञवज्ञभन्न कदम ईठाए हैं।

व्यलक्तयों क े  ललए रोजगार और आजीलवका क े  अवसरों को बढावा कदया जा सक े । 
 
 कमभचारी राज्य बीमा लनगम (ईएसआईसी) द्वारा कायाभलनवत की जा रही अटल बीलमत व्यलक्त 
कल्याण योजना क े  तहत, बेरोजगारी लाभ को औसत वेतन का 25% से बढा कर 50% कर कदया गया है ,जो 
कक 90 कदनों तक देय है। इसक े  साथ -साथ लाभ लेने क े  ललए पात्रता शतों में छूट है।  
 
 सरकार पयाभप्त लनवेश वाली लवलभन्न पररयोजनाओं को प्रोत्सालहत कर रही है और प्रधान मंत्री 
रोजगार सृजन कायभक्रम (पीएमईजीपी) , महात् मा  गांधी राष् रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी योजना 
(एमजीएनआरईजीएस) , पं. दीन दयाल उपाध् याय ग्रामीण कौशल् य योजना (डीडीयू-जीक े वाई), दीनदयाल 
अंत्योदय योजना - राष् रीय शहरी आजीलवका लमशन (डीएवाई -एनयूएलएम) तथा प्रधान मंत्री कौशल 
लवकास योजना (पीएमक े वीवाई) जैसी योजनाओं पर सावभजलनक व्यय करना।  
 
 सरकार ने एमजीएनआरईजीए मजदूरी को 182 रुपए प्रलतकदन से बढाकर 202 रुपये प्रलतकदन कर 
कदया है लजससे लगभग 13.62 करोड़ पररवारों को लाभ लमला है।  
 
 सरकार ने स्व-रोजगार को सुकर बनाने क े  ललए , अनय बातों क े  साथ-साथ, प्रधानमंत्री मुद्रा योजना 
(पीएमएमवाई) भी आरंभ की है। पीएमएमवाई क े  अंतगभत सूक्ष्म/लघु व्यापररक उद्यमों तथा व्यलक्तयों को 
अपने व्यापाररक कायभकलापों को स्थालपत करने अथवा लवस्तार करने में समथभ बनाने क े  ललए 10 लाख 
रुपए तक का गैर -जमानती ऋण प्रदान ककया जाता है। 
 
 इसक े  अलावा , आरबीआई एवं भारत सरकार ने बाजार अथभव्यवस्था को बनाए रखने एवं रोजगार 
क े  स्तर को बढाने क े  ललए अथभव्यवस्था में तरलता बढाने क े  ललए उपायों की शुरूआत की है। 
 
मेक इन इंलडया , लडलजटल इंलडया , स्वच्छ भारत लमशन, स्माटभ लसटी लमशन, अटल नवीकरण और

2017-18, 2018-19 एवं 2019 -20 क े  दौरान आयोवजत ककए गए आववधक श्रम बल सवेक्षण

की अनुमावनत बेरोजगारी दर (यूआर) क्रमशिः 6.0%, 5.8% एवं 4.8% है।  
 
 सांवख्यकी और कायघक्रम कायाघन्वयन मंत्रालय औपचाररक क्षेत्र में रोजगार से संबंवधत मावसक पे -
रोल आंकडो का प्रकाशन भी कर रहा है। यह दशाघता है कक वषघ 2020 -21 क े  वलए कमघचारी भववष्य वनवध 
संगठन (ईपीएफओ) अंशदाता आधार में संचयी शुद्ध पे -रोल वृवद्ध 77.08 लाख है, जो कक वपछले वषघ

2020-21 क े प्रत्येक माह में ईपीएफओ अंशदाता आधार द्वारा दशाघए गए शुद्ध पे-रोल में वृवद्ध हुई है।

अथघव्यवस्थाओं को प्रभाववत ककया है। सरकार ने महामारी से उत्पन्न चुनौवतयों एवं खतरों क े  समाधान क े 
वलए अनेक कदम उठाए हैं।  
  
सरकार आत्मवनभघर भारत ववत्तीय पैक े ज क े अंग क े रूप में सत्ताईस लाख करोड़ रुपए से अवधक का 
राजकोषीय प्रोत्साहन प्रदान कर रही है। आत्मवनभघर भारत पैक े ज में देश को आत्मवनभघर बनाने तथा 
रोजगार अवसर सृवजत करने क े  वलए वववभन्न दीघघकावलक योजनाएं/कायघक्रम/नीवतयां शावमल हैं।

रोजगार क े  सृजन हेतु वनयोिाओं को प्रोत्सावहत करने तथा रोजगार की पुनिः बहाली हेतु 1 अि ू बर, 2020 
से प्रारंभ की गई है। ईपीएफओ क े  माध्यम से कायाघवन्वत की जा रही यह योजना वनयोिाओं क े  ववत्तीय 
बोझ को कम करने और उन्हें अवधक कामगारों को कायघ पर रखने क े  वलए प्रोत्सावहत करने का प्रयास करती 
है। लाभार्थथयों क े  पंजीकरण की अंवतम वतवथ को 30 जून , 2021 से बढ़ाकर 31 माचघ, 2022 कर कदया 
गया है।

करने क े  वलए देश में नवाचार और स्टाटघअप क े  पोषण क े  वलए एक मजबूत पाररवस्थवतकी तंत्र क े  वनमाघण क े 
वलए एक प्रमुख पहल , स्टाटघअप इंवडया शुरू की है।

और शहरी पररवतघन वमशन , सभी क े  वलए आवास , अवसंरचना ववकास तथा औद्योवगक गवलयारों तथा

अवसर सृवजत करने की संभावना है  
 
कौशल ववकास और उद्यमशीलता मंत्रालय (एमएसडीई) ने गरीब कल्याण रोजगार अवभयान 
(जीक े आरए) को समथघन देने क े  वलए अपनी फ्लैगवशप योजना , प्रधानमंत्री कौशल ववकास योजना

कायघक्रम लागू ककया है।  इस ववशेष कायघक्रम में 6 राज्यों नामतिः असम , वबहार , मध्य प्रदेश, ओवडशा,

2653. डा. ककरोडी लाल मीणााः 
 
क्या श्रम और रोजगार  मंत्री यह बताने की क ृ पा करेंगे ककाः  
 
(क)  द्धवगत पांच वषों और वततमान वषत क े  दौरान देश में रोजगार/बेरोजगारी दर का राज्य/संघ राज्य 
क्षेत्र-वार ब्यौरा क्या है; और  
(ख) क्या द्धवगत तीन वषों और वततमान वषत क े  दौरान बेरोजगारी दर में तीव्र वृद्धि हुई है, यकद हां, तो 
इसक े  क्या कारण हैं और बेरोजगारी पर रोक लगाने क े  संबंध में क्या प्रस्ताव है? 
 
उत्तर  
श्रम और रोजगार राज्य मंत्री  
 (श्री रामेश्वर तेली) 
 
(क) एवं (ख): रोजगार/बेरोजगारी से संबंद्धधत आंकडे राष्ट्रीय सांद्धख्यकी कायातलय (एनएसओ), सांद्धख्यकी 
एवं कायतक्रम कायातन्वयन मंत्रालय (एमओएसपीआई) द्वारा आयोद्धजत ककए जाने वाले आवद्धधक श्रम बल 
सवेक्षण (पीएलएफएस) क े माध्यम से 2017-18 से एकत्र ककए जा रहे हैं। वषत 2017 -18, 2018-19 एवं 
2019-20 क े  दौरान आयोद्धजत ककए गए पीएलएफएस क े  पररणामों क े  अनुसार , देश में सामान्य द्धस्थद्धत 
आधार पर 15 वषत और उससे अद्धधक आयु क े  व्यद्धियों का अनुमाद्धनत कामगार जनसंख्या अनुपात 
(डब््यूपीआर) तथा अनुमाद्धनत बेरोजगारी दर (यूआर) का उपलब्ध सीमा तक राज्य/संघ राज्य क्षेत्र-वार 
ब्यौरा अनुबंध पर कदया गया है।  
 
भारत सरकार ने देश में रोजगार सृजन को बढावा देने क े  द्धलए अनेक कदम उठाए हैं। आत्मद्धनभतर 
भारत रोजगार योजना (एबीआरवाई) सामाद्धजक सुरक्षा लाभों सद्धहत नए रोजगार क े  सृजन हेतु 
द्धनयोिाओं को प्रोत्साद्धहत करने क े द्धलए तथा रोजगार की पुनाःबहाली क े  द्धलए 1 अि ू बर, 2020 से आरंभ 
की गई है। इस योजना क े  तहत लाभाथी क े  पंजीकरण की अंद्धतम द्धतद्धथ को 30 जून, 2021 से बढाकर 31 
माचत, 2022 ककया गया है।

प
ीएम स्व-द्धनद्धध योजना ने रेहडी-पटरी वालों को कोद्धवड पश्च अवद्धध क े  दौरान कफर से अपना 
व्यापार शुरू करने में सहायता करने क े  द्धलए एक वषत की अवद्धध क े  द्धलए 10,000/- रु. तक का गैर -जमानती 
कायतकारी पूंजीगत ऋण प्रदान करने क े कायत को सरल बनाया है।  
 
सरकार द्वारा स्व-रोजगार को सुकर बनाने क े  द्धलए , अन्य बातों क े  साथ -साथ, प्रधानमंत्री मुद्रा 
योजना (पीएमएमवाई) कायातद्धन्वत की जा रही है। पीएमएमवाई क े  अंतगतत सूक्ष्म/लघु व्यापररक उद्यमों 
तथा व्यद्धियों को अपने व्यापाररक कायतकलापों को स्थाद्धपत करने अथवा द्धवस्तार करने में समथत बनाने क े  
द्धलए 10 लाख रुपए तक का गैर -जमानती ऋण प्रदान ककया जाता है।  
 
 
इसक े  अद्धतररि, रोजगार सृजन को बढाने क े  द्धलए, सरकार देश में पयातप्त द्धनवेश वाली द्धवद्धभन्न 
पररयोजनाओं को प्रोत्साद्धहत कर रही है और प्रधान मंत्री रोजगार सृजन कायतक्रम (पीएमईजीपी), महात् मा 
गांधी राष्‍ट रीय मीणामीण रोजगार गारंटी योजना (एमजीएनआरईजीएस), पं. दीन दयाल उपाध् याय मीणामीण 
कौश् य योजना (डीडीयू -जीक े वाई), दीनदयाल अंत्योदय योजना - रा ष्‍ट रीय शहरी आजीद्धवका द्धमशन 
(डीएवाई-एनयूएलएम) तथा प्रधान मंत्री कौशल द्धवकास योजना (पीएमक े वीवाई) जो कक क्रमशाः सूक्ष्म, 
लघु और मध्यम उद्यम मंत्रालय, मीणामीण द्धवकास मंत्रालय, आवास एवं शहरी कायत मंत्रालय तथा कौशल 
द्धवकास एवं उद्यमशीलता मंत्रालय (एमएसडीई) द्वारा संचाद्धलत की जा रही हैं, जैसी योजनाओं पर 
सावतजद्धनक व्यय करना। 
 
इन पहलों क े  अद्धतररि, मेक इन इंद्धडया, द्धडद्धजटल इंद्धडया, स्वच्छ भारत द्धमशन, स्माटत द्धसटी 
द्धमशन, जीणोिार एवं शहरी रूपांतरण हेतु अटल द्धमशन , सभी क े  द्धलए आवास, अवसंरचना द्धवकास तथा 
औद्योद्धगक गद्धलयारों तथा उत्पादन-संबि प्रोत्साहन (पीएलआई) योजना जैसे सरकार क े  फ्लैगशीप 
कायतक्रमों में उत्पादक रोजगार क े  अवसर सृद्धजत करने की संभावना है।

 क्मा श्रम और रोजगार मंत्री मह फताने की क ृऩा कयेंगे कक:  
 
(क)  क्मा सड़क ऩरयवहन संफंधी काभगायों के लरए साभाजिक स ुयऺा अधधननमभ का कोई प्रस्ताव है; औय

 क्या इस्पात मंत्री यह बताने की कृपा करेंगे कक:  
 
(क)  क्या यह सच है कक स्टील अथॉररटी ऑफ इंडिया लललमटेि (सेल) के कममचाररयों तथा अधिकाररयों

2662.  श्री मो. नदीमुऱ हक:   
क्या श्रम और रोजगार मंत्री यह बताने की कृऩा करेंगे कक:  
 
(क)  क्या घरेऱू कामगारों को सामाजजक स ुरऺा कवर प्रदान करने वाऱी कोई योजना मौज ूद है ;  
(ख)  यदद हां, तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है;  
(ग)  ऐसी योजनाओं के अंतगगत ककतने प्रततशत घरेऱ ू कामगार सामाजजक स ुरऺा कवर प्राप्त कर 
रहे हैं, तत्संबंधी राज्य-वार ब्यौरा क्या है;  
(घ)  क्या घरेऱू कामगारों के अधधकारों की रऺा के लऱए कोई कान ून मौज ू
द है;  
(ङ)  यदद हां, तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है और यदद नहीं, तो इसके क्या कारह हैं ;  
(च)  क्या ऩूहगकालऱक घरेऱ ू कामगारों के लऱए घरों में श्रम कानूनों के अन ुऩाऱन की तनगरानी करने 
हेत ु कोई तंत्र मौज ूद है ; और  
(छ)  यदद हां, तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है और यदद नहीं, तो इसके क्या कारह हैं ? 
 
उत्तर 
श्रम और रोजगार राज्य मंत्री 
(श्री रामेश्वर तेऱी) 
 
(क) से (छ): अब सामाजजक स ुरऺा संदहता , 2020 में समादहत ककए गए असंगदित कामगार 
सामाजजक स ुरऺा अधधतनयम , 2008 में घरेऱ ू कामगारों सदहत सभी असंगदित कामगारों की 
सामाजजक स ुरऺा के उऩबंध हैं। सरकार ने वषग 2015 में जीवन और तन:शक्तता कवर के लऱए प्रधान 
मंत्री जीवन ज्योतत बीमा योजना (ऩीएमजेजेबीवाई) और प्रधान मंत्री स ुरऺा बीमा योजना 
(ऩीएमएसबीवाई) जैसी सामाजजक स ुरऺा योजनाएं तथा घरेऱ ू कामगारों सदहत असंगदित कामगारों की 
ऩेंशन के लऱए माचग, 2019 में प्रधान मंत्री श्रम योगी मान धन योजना (ऩीएम-एसवाईएम) प्रारंभ की 
है। कौशऱ ववकास और उद्यलमता मंत्राऱय के अंतगगत घरेऱ ू कामगार ऺेत्र कौशऱ ऩररषद 
(डीडब््यूएसएससी) घरेऱू कामगारों को ववलभन्न कौशऱ ववकास प्रलशऺह कायगक्रम प्रदान कर रही है। 
वषग 2018 में आरंभ की गई आय ुष्मान भारत प्रधान मंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (ऩीएमजेएवाई) में 
सामाजजक आधथगक जातत जनगहना के आंकडे , 2011 के अन ुसार ऩात्र ऱाभाधथगयों के रूऩ में कवर 
ककए गए घरेऱ ू कामगारों सदहत सभी असंगदित कामगारों के लऱए द्ववतीयक और त ृतीयक स्वास््य 
ऱाभों हेत ु 5 ऱाख रुऩये स्वास््य कवरेज प्रदान करती है। श्रम संदहताएं अथागत मजद ूरी संदहता , 
2019, व्यावसातयक स ुरऺा, स्वास््य और कायगदशाएं संदहता, 2020 और सामाजजक स ुरऺा संदहता ,

2020 में घरेऱ ू कामगारों सदहत कामगारों की सभी श्रेणहयों के लऱए मयागददत कायगदशाएं , न्यूनतम
